sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:1
items.html: The first state is when she is a point below the Yesod of ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:2
items.html: The second state, on the fourth day of the days of creation, when she was in the third aspect of the aspects of the Mochin of the posterior of YESHSUT, which are the illumination of the head from above downward; then was the diminishment of the moon.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:3
items.html: The third state, after the diminishment of the moon, when she returned to a point, and her upper nine ascended to ZA.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:4
items.html: The fourth state, on the sixth day of the days of creation, when she returned and grew to the third aspect of the aspects of the Mochin of the posterior of YESHSUT.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:5
items.html: The fifth state, the coupling of ZON for the birth of Adam HaRishon in the Hall of Aba and Ima. And had Adam HaRishon not sinned, ZON would have coupled afterward in this aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:6
items.html: The sixth state, after the sin of Adam HaRishon, when the Nukva returned to a point, and her lower nine fell into the Klipot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:7
items.html: The seventh state, when she returned and was corrected in the sixth aspect, which is face to face, from the Mochin of Aba and Ima.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:8
items.html: The eighth state, on the first day after the Sabbath of creation, when the Nukva returned to the aspect of back to back from the chest and below, without the illumination of the head, which is the aspect of VAK lacking GAR entirely, namely VAK of Ruach. They are attached back to back in a single wall.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:9
items.html: The ninth state is what was changed by the sin of the seven generations, which raised her above the seven firmaments, and her seven lower, which rose to her GAR — that is, the aspect of three within three — are found, and nothing remained but the aspect of Nefesh.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:10
items.html: The tenth state is at the time of the seven righteous, from Abraham to Moses, when they returned and lowered her as she was before the departure, namely to back to back from the chest and below, and both are attached in a single wall, without the illumination of the head.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:11
items.html: The eleventh state is on the tenth of the month, when the Nukva was back to back from the chest and below, namely as in the tenth state above, except that by the taking of the Paschal offering, when the days of the examination began, the illuminations of the head began to shine in her.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:12
items.html: The twelfth state is on the fifteenth of the month, on the night of Passover, when, by this — having received the illuminations of the head of ZA, from the aspect of the Mochin of Aba and Ima — she returned face to face, in the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:13
items.html: The thirteenth state is after the first night of Passover, when she immediately returned to the point of back to back, but in the third aspect of the posterior, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, namely back to back, with the illumination of the head from above downward. And this continued until the building of the First Temple, except on the Shabbats, when she returned to the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:14
items.html: The fourteenth state is at the time of the First Temple, when she returned to the sixth aspect, which is face to face in an equal stature, from the aspect of the Mochin of Aba and Ima; and this was corrected in her permanently, even on weekdays. And nothing was lacking to her except this seventh degree, for had she attained it, no nation or tongue would have been able to rule over us anymore.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:15
items.html: The fifteenth state is at the moment of the destruction of the First Temple, when she returned to a point below the Yesod; had this not been, the Klipot and the nations of the world would not have had the ability to destroy the Temple. And then her upper nine ascended to ZA, and did not descend to the Klipot.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:16
items.html: The sixteenth state is immediately after the destruction, when she returned to be a complete Partzuf from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head, which is the third aspect of back to back, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, as she was before the building of the First Temple. And this continued until the building of the Second Temple.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:17
items.html: The seventeenth state is in the Second Temple, when she was corrected permanently in the third aspect of face to face, from the Mochin of YESHSUT, which is the fifth of the seven aspects, namely face to face from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head from above downward. This is the secret of what was lacking there — five things, namely the aspect of the clothing of the illuminations of the head of ZA in their place, which is the sixth aspect, as it was in the First Temple permanently; this was lacking to her in the Second Temple, for she had only the fifth aspect. Except on the Shabbats, when she had the sixth aspect.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:18
items.html: The eighteenth state is at the destruction of the Second Temple, when, by the destruction, she returned to the aspect of a point, and her lower nine fell into the Klipot. This resembles the state after the sin of Adam HaRishon, except that the difference is: there it caused the correction of the Klipot, for before his sin the Klipot had no correction; but at the time of the destruction, the Klipot had already been corrected; rather, they caused the holiness to return and clothe within the Klipa.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:19
items.html: The nineteenth state is at the time of the exile after the Second Temple, when, by the prayer, she is raised up to the fifth aspect, which is face to face from the chest and below, with the illumination of the head from above downward. But outside the time of prayer, she is in the aspect of a point below the Yesod. And this is on weekdays.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 59:20
items.html: (To the question) The twentieth state is on the Shabbats at the time of the exile, when, at the time of the Musaf prayer, she is raised to the sixth aspect, which clothes the illuminations of the head of ZA in their place; they are the aspect of face to face in an equal stature, from the Mochin of Aba and Ima. (Items 15 to 55).
